types.name: NodeMetadata
docs: location as [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html) country code

types.name: NodeRef
docs: A reference to a node in the cluster.
The offset is to derive the Node Account.
The current_total_rewards is the total rewards the node has received so far in the current
epoch.

types.name: OpenPositionOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: Output
docs: An output of a computation.
We currently don't support encrypted outputs yet since encrypted values are passed via
data objects.

types.name: Parameter
docs: A parameter of a computation.
We differentiate between plaintext and encrypted parameters and data objects.
Plaintext parameters are directly provided as their value.
Encrypted parameters are provided as an offchain reference to the data.
Data objects are provided as a reference to the data object account.

types.name: Position
docs: Encrypted position account - all sensitive data stored encrypted

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner of the position

fields.name: market
docs: Market this position belongs to

fields.name: encrypted_data
docs: Encrypted position data (size, entry_price, leverage, direction)
This blob is only decryptable within MPC

fields.name: status
docs: Position status

fields.name: opened_at
docs: Timestamp when position was opened

fields.name: closed_at
docs: Timestamp when position was closed (0 if still open)

fields.name: margin
docs: Deprecated plaintext margin slot (legacy compatibility only).
New flow keeps this at 0 while a position is active and settles using
MPC-revealed lock amount in callbacks.

fields.name: requested_margin
docs: Pending-time user margin cap used during open-position validation.
Cleared once callback transitions position to Open.

fields.name: realized_pnl
docs: Realized PnL (only set after position is closed)
This is the ONLY data revealed - and only at settlement

fields.name: nonce
docs: Nonce used for encryption

fields.name: client_pubkey
docs: Client public key for shared secret

fields.name: index
docs: Position index (unique identifier)

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for PDA derivation

fields.name: pending_computation_account
docs: The computation account key recorded when this position's MPC computation was queued.
Callbacks verify that the computation_account passed to them matches this key,
binding each callback to the specific computation that was authorised for this position.
Cleared to Pubkey::default() after the callback consumes it.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Reserved space for future upgrades

types.name: PositionClosed
docs: Event emitted when a position is closed.
Settlement details are intentionally omitted to reduce public strategy leakage.

types.name: PositionLiquidated
docs: Event emitted when a position is liquidated.
liquidation_price is intentionally omitted — revealing it would let observers
reconstruct leverage/direction from margin + price. Only the fact of liquidation
is public, matching the MPC circuit's boolean-only output guarantee.

types.name: PositionOpened
docs: Event emitted when a position is opened
Note: size, direction and margin are not revealed here.

types.name: PositionStatus
docs: Position status enum

types.name: PriceUpdated
docs: Event emitted when oracle price is updated

types.name: SetUnset
docs: Utility struct to store a value that needs to be set by a certain number of participants (keys
in our case). Once all participants have set the value, the value is considered set and we only
store it once.
